result: Added a per-enemy `flash.gdshader` material to the enemy's Sprite2D in `scripts/enemy.gd`, and `hit()` now sets `amount` to 1 and tweens it to 0 over 0.2s. Note that a killing hit still frees the enemy immediately, so the flash won't be visible on those hits. The review reports no errors, but I couldn't run the game.
